use_case_name: Update the Facility Map and Displayed Devices

claims.content: To allow the System Administrator to modify the facility map and add or remove devices from the display without requiring programming effort.

goal.raw_text: To allow the System Administrator to modify the facility map and add or remove devices from the display without requiring programming effort.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator is logged into the RLCS Software with System Administrative privileges.
The GUI is accessible and displaying the I-15 Reversible Lane Control System facility geographic area, including layout of mainline I-15, SR-163 freeway area.
Device sensor status and controller information are available for display using dynamic icons.
The system allows modification of the facility map without requiring programming effort.
The system allows devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.
The System Administrator initiates a request to modify the facility map or add/remove devices from the display via the GUI configuration option.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates a request to modify the facility map or add/remove devices from the display via the GUI configuration option.

claims.content: The System Administrator accesses the GUI configuration option to modify the facility map or add/remove devices from the display.
The GUI allows the facility map to be modified without requiring programming effort.
The GUI allows devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.
When changes are made, the GUI configuration screen displays to the user which device, controller, or workstation in the RLCS network will be affected by the changes.
The system updates the displayed facility geographic area, including layout of mainline I-15, SR-163 freeway area, reflecting the modifications.
Device sensor status using dynamic icons for all field device sensors and controllers is updated on the display as applicable.
If the System Administrator attempts to configure device rules, the system shall require an additional login password for that option.
If a device status has been overridden, on the screen it shall appear with different color from the normal and alarm status colors.
For alarm status, the GUI shall issue an audible alarm, and the icon shall be different from the okay status for that device. The visual alarm shall include a change of color for the affected device.
The System Administrator may turn off the audible alarm permanently or temporarily for a given period.
When the alarm condition is removed, the alarm icon shall change to the normal status icon automatically.
When the system administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI shall analyze the data before storing in the database and notify the system administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.
The facility map is modified without requiring programming effort.
Devices are added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.

The GUI provides a display of the I-15 Reversible Lane Control System facility geographic area, including a layout of the mainline I-15, SR-163 freeway area in the same geographic area as the I-15 Reversible Lane.
Screen information includes Facility status (e.g. 'Open' or 'Closed').
Screen information includes Current direction of traffic flow.
Screen information includes Customer eligibility (e.g. 'RLCS and FasTrak Only', 'All Traffic').
Screen information includes Current facility boundaries extending one mile in either direction.
Device sensor status using dynamic icons for all field device sensors and controllers is displayed.
